regions.text: A certain party interested in The Masses has 75 Suits and Overcoats valued at $15 $20 each. They are to be donated to persons sending 20 yearly subscriptions. GET IN ON IT. THERE ARE ONLY 75

regions.label: text
regions.text: We prefer subscriptions to a gift. The money spent in purchasing these garments will come to us through your subscriptions as well as if we had received it direct. We will have 1,500 new readers and 75 hustlers who are under obligations to us. That's why. The suits are 36-38 Breast Measure. The overcoats range from 36-42. We ship express collect either a suit or overcoat upon receipt of 20 subscriptions. We don't want merely 20 names. We want 20 subscriptions. Sample copies supplied.
